text: XPEL, Inc. is a listed company; per its 2026 proxy statement the beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock are BlackRock (14.6%), Wasatch Advisors (13.8%), The Vanguard Group (5.3%) and Alta Fox Capital Management (5.2%) — asset managers, with no state or sovereign-fund holder.
short: XPEL is Nasdaq-listed; BlackRock, Wasatch, Vanguard and Alta Fox are its >5% holders.

source.name: XPEL, Inc. 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Certain Beneficial Owners: BlackRock, Inc. (1) 3,906,962 14.6% Wasatch Advisors, LP (2) 3,814,500 13.8% The Vanguard Group (3) 1,475,149 5.3% Alta Fox Capital Management LLC (4) 1,438,831 5.2%
